assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Oblique sketch of a cube with three hidden edges grey dashed. The plane section is the shaded rhombus OPQR: O is the front lower-left vertex, Q the opposite back upper-right vertex, P the midpoint of the front right vertical edge and R the midpoint of the back left vertical edge; OP and PQ are solid blue and QR and RO are dashed blue.
